title: Guide Effort Tool
output: flexdashboard::flex_dashboard
runtime: shiny
self_contained: true

```{r notes, include= FALSE}
### SECTIONS:
# import_surveys: This section prepares the environment the Shiny data tool by loading the required packages, importing a local Excel log, and retrieving clinical study data from REDCap via API. It sets up a function to export REDCap data and then uses it to download data sets for specific studies.

# clean_imported_surveys: This section cleans and standardizes data from the REDCap studies and the guide_log by formatting dates, assigning study phases, filtering incomplete records, and harmonizing variables. The cleaned datasets are then exported as CSV files for further use. 

# combine_studies: This section defined and applies a function to extract and label relevant guide-related data from multiple studies, combines the results into a single dataset, and standardizes columns names and formatting for consistency and analysis.

# guide_effort_table: This code maps event names to visit numbers, aggregates and formats clinical guide data by participant and study, estimates key study dates, merges with the guide log, and standardizes guide names by grouping and harmonizing similar entries.

# guide_summary: This code creates two summary tables of clinical and secondary guides: one (guide_summary_part1) that aggregates visit types and total hours worked per guide, and another (guide_summary_part2) that summarizes participant progress and completion rates per guide. Both parts reshape the data to treat Clinical and Secondary Guides uniformly and standardize guide names.

# display: This creates the Shiny app that provides an interactive dashboard to filter, visualize, and summarize clinical guide participation data from studies, with side panels for filtering options and summary statistics, and a center panel for displaying data tables. It includes customized UI styling and reactive server logic to dynamically update content based on user input. 

### NOTES:
# ***"CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES": if you search (command/control f) through the R markdown file for this exact wording, you will be able to find the parts that need to be modified when new studies are added
```

```{r clean_imported_surveys, include = FALSE}
get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- na.omit(unique(x))
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

###CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES
### =====STUDY_1 STUDY=====
study_1_clean <- study_1 %>%
  mutate(
    fvf_visitdate = as.Date(fvf_visitdate), # Convert visit date to Date format
    date = ymd(fvf_visitdate),  # Convert to date format
    study_name = "STUDY_1",      # Add study name
    vol_id = as.numeric(vol_id), # Fixes vol_id numbers
    study_phase = case_when(    # Assign study phase based on redcap_event_name
      grepl("screen|baseline|prep", redcap_event_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Prep",
      grepl("session", redcap_event_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Dosing",
      grepl("int", redcap_event_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Integration",
      grepl("month", redcap_event_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Follow-Up",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    fvf_duration = as.integer(fvf_duration), # Ensure duration is an integer
    fvf_facilitator1 = na_if(fvf_facilitator1, ""), # Convert blank facilitators to NA
    fvf_facilitator2 = na_if(fvf_facilitator2, "")
  ) %>%
  arrange(vol_id, date) %>%  # Arrange data by vol_id and date
  select(
    study_name, vol_id, fvf_facilitator1, fvf_facilitator2, fvf_visitdate,
    study_phase, redcap_event_name, visit, fvf_duration
  ) %>%
  # Fixes errors when Clinical or Secondary Guide is blank for most but has entry for one
  group_by(vol_id) %>%
  mutate(
    fvf_facilitator1 = if_else(
      is.na(fvf_facilitator1),
      get_mode(fvf_facilitator1),
      fvf_facilitator1
    ),
    fvf_facilitator2 = if_else(
      is.na(fvf_facilitator2),
      get_mode(fvf_facilitator2),
      fvf_facilitator2
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# FUNCTION TO CLEAN AND STANDARDIZE DATE VALUE IN GUIDE LOG
clean_dates <- function(date_column) {
  # Convert to character
  date_column <- as.character(date_column)
  
  # Trim whitespace
  date_column <- trimws(date_column)
  
  # Replace text-based values with NA
  date_column <- ifelse(
    str_detect(date_column, "missing|approx|ghosted|dropped|Withdrew|TBD|\\?|not listed"), 
    NA, 
    date_column
  )

  # Convert Excel serial numbers
  is_numeric <- suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(date_column)))
  date_column[is_numeric] <- as.character(as.Date(as.numeric(date_column[is_numeric]), origin = "1899-12-30"))

  # Parse dates using lubridate
  parsed_dates <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(date_column, orders = c("mdy", "dmy", "ymd", "Ymd", "mdY"), tz = "UTC"))

  return(parsed_dates)
}

# CLEAN DATES IN GUIDE LOG
guide_log <- guide_log %>%
```

```{r combine_studies, include = FALSE}
### FUNCTION TO QUERY GUIDE DATA FROM FACILITATOR VISIT FORM
guideeffort_bystudy <- function(data, study_name){
  guide_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(c('vol_id', 'study_phase', 'redcap_event_name', visit, starts_with('fvf_'))) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    filter(!all(across(starts_with("fvf_"), is.na))) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  study_name <- rep(study_name, nrow(guide_data))
  
  guide_data <- cbind(study_name, guide_data)
  return(guide_data)
}

### APPLY FUNCTION TO EACH DATA SET // CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES

study_2_guide_data <- guideeffort_bystudy(study_2_clean, study_name = 'STUDY_2')
study_4_guide_data <- guideeffort_bystudy(study_4_clean, study_name = 'STUDY_4')
study_3_guide_data <- guideeffort_bystudy(study_3_clean, study_name = 'STUDY_3')


### CREATE COMBINED DATA FRAME WITH GUIDE DATA FROM ALL STUDIES // CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES

    'Date' = fvf_visitdate,

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    'Clinical Guide' = toupper(`Clinical Guide`),
    'Secondary Guide' = toupper(`Secondary Guide`),
    'Visit Progress' = visit
  )
```

```{r guide_effort_table, include = FALSE}
### FUNCTION TO CONCATENATE UNIQUE VALUES
unique_names <- function(x) {
  paste(unique(x), collapse = "/")
}

### SELECT RELEVANT COLUMNS AND GROUP DATA (VIEW 1)
set.seed(123)
guide_effort_table <- all_guide_data[c("Study", 
                          "Participant ID", 
                          "Clinical Guide", 
                          "Secondary Guide", 
                          "Visit Name",
                          "Visit Progress",
                          "Study Phase",
                          "Date",

                        )]


### AGGREGATE AND SUMMARIZE VIEW1 DATA BY PARTICIPANT ID AND STUDY
guide_effort_table <- guide_effort_table %>%
  # Set Visit Progress to NA if it's 999
  mutate(
    `Visit Progress` = ifelse(`Visit Progress` == 999, NA, `Visit Progress`)
  ) %>%
  
  # CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES
  mutate(
    `Visit Progress` = ifelse(
      Study == "STUDY_3" & (is.na(`Visit Progress`) | is.infinite(`Visit Progress`)), unname(event_to_visit[`Visit Name`]),
      `Visit Progress`
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Participant ID`, `Study`) %>%
  summarise(
    # Get the earliest date (first prep session)
    `Start Date (First Prep)` = min(`Date`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Combine unique Clinical Guides names into a single string
    `Clinical Guide` = unique_names(`Clinical Guide`),
    
    # Combine unique Secondary Guide names into a single string
    `Secondary Guide` = unique_names(`Secondary Guide`),
    
    # Get the maximum visit progress for each participant
    `Visit Progress` = max(`Visit Progress`, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Assign the study phase corresponding to the most recent visit date
    `Study Phase` = `Study Phase`[which.max(`Date`)]
            ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Format Visit Progress based on the study type // CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES
    mutate(
      `Visit Progress` = case_when(
      `Study` == "STUDY_1" ~ paste((`Visit Progress` + 1), "/16", sep = ""),
      `Study` == "STUDY_2" ~ paste((`Visit Progress` + 1), "/20", sep = ""),
      `Study` == "STUDY_3" ~ paste(`Visit Progress`, "/28", sep = ""),
      `Study` == "STUDY_4" ~ paste(`Visit Progress`, "/10", sep = ""),
      TRUE ~ as.character(`Visit Progress`)
    )
  )

# Calculate expected end dates based on study type // CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES
guide_effort_table <- guide_effort_table %>%
  mutate(
    'End Date (last integration before follow-up)' = case_when(
      `Study` == 'STUDY_2' ~ as.Date(`Start Date (First Prep)`) + 12*7,
      `Study` == 'STUDY_1' ~ as.Date(`Start Date (First Prep)`) + 8*7,
      TRUE ~ NA_Date_
    ),
    'End Date (LTFU)' = case_when(
      `Study` == 'STUDY_2' ~ as.Date(`Start Date (First Prep)`) + 65*7,
      `Study` == 'STUDY_1' ~ as.Date(`Start Date (First Prep)`) + 52*7,
      TRUE ~ NA_Date_
    )
  )

### FUNCTION TO GET THE MOST FREQUENT VALUE
most_frequent <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

### FUNCTION TO STANDARDIZE NAMES
library(stringdist)

standardize_name <- function(name_vector) {
  name_vector <- as.character(name_vector)
  name_vector[is.na(name_vector)] <- ""
  name_vector <- trimws(name_vector)
  
  # Clean special characters
  name_vector <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z/,\\- ]", "", name_vector, perl = TRUE)
  name_vector <- gsub("\\s+", " ", name_vector)
  name_vector <- gsub("-", " ", name_vector)  # Replace hyphens with spaces
  name_vector <- gsub("\\bNOT PRESENT\\b", "", name_vector, ignore.case = TRUE)
  name_vector <- gsub(",\\s*MD\\b", "", name_vector)
  
  # Normalize slashes and remove duplicates per entry
  name_vector <- sapply(name_vector, function(name) {
    guides <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(name, "/"))))
    paste(guides, collapse = "/")
  })

  # Get all unique individual guide names
  all_guides <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(name_vector, "/"))))
  all_guides <- all_guides[all_guides != ""]
  

  # Tokenize each guide name into lowercase words
  guide_tokens <- lapply(all_guides, function(name) {
    tokens <- unlist(strsplit(tolower(name), " "))
    tokens[tokens != ""]
  })
  
  # Group similar names (≥2 token overlap)
  grouped_names <- list()
  used <- rep(FALSE, length(all_guides))
  
  for (i in seq_along(all_guides)) {
    if (used[i]) next
    group <- i
    for (j in seq_along(all_guides)) {
      if (i != j && !used[j]) {
        shared <- intersect(guide_tokens[[i]], guide_tokens[[j]])
        if (length(shared) >= 2) {
          group <- c(group, j)
        }
      }
    }
    grouped_names[[length(grouped_names) + 1]] <- all_guides[unique(group)]
  }

  # Map each name to the longest name in its group
  guide_map <- list()
  for (group in grouped_names) {
    canonical <- group[which.max(nchar(group))][1]
    for (name in group) {
      guide_map[[name]] <- canonical
    }
  }

  # Apply mapping
  name_vector <- sapply(name_vector, function(x) {
    parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, "/")))
    cleaned_parts <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
      p <- trimws(p)
      val <- guide_map[[p]]
      if (is.null(val)) p else val
    }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    cleaned_parts <- as.character(cleaned_parts)
    paste(sort(unique(cleaned_parts)), collapse = "/")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  # Correct slight variations using approximate matching
  unique_names <- unique(unlist(strsplit(name_vector, "/")))  # Get all individual guides
  if (length(unique_names) > 1) {
    for (i in seq_along(unique_names)) {
      for (j in seq_along(unique_names)) {
        if (i != j && stringdist::stringdist(unique_names[i], unique_names[j]) <= 2) {
          name_vector <- gsub(paste0("\\b", unique_names[j], "\\b"), unique_names[i], name_vector)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  name_vector <- sapply(name_vector, function(name) {
    parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(name, "/")))
    parts <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
      if (p %in% names(manual_map)) manual_map[[p]] else p 
    })
    paste(parts, collapse = "/")
  }) 

  return(name_vector)
}


### APPLY STANDARDIZE NAME FUNCTION TO GUIDE EFFORT TABLE AT THE SAME TIME
# Step 1: Pull all unique names from both columns
all_names <- unique(c(guide_effort_table$`Clinical Guide`, guide_effort_table$`Secondary Guide`))

# Step 2: Create a mapping of original to standardized names
name_mapping <- setNames(standardize_name(all_names), all_names)

# Step 3: Apply the mapping back to both columns
guide_effort_table <- guide_effort_table %>%
  mutate(
    `Clinical Guide` = name_mapping[`Clinical Guide`],
    `Secondary Guide` = name_mapping[`Secondary Guide`]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !(tolower(`Clinical Guide`) == "test" | tolower(`Secondary Guide`) == "test"),
    !is.na(`Participant ID`),
    `Participant ID` != ""
  )
```

```{r guide_summary, include = FALSE}
### GUIDE SUMMARY TABLE
### VIEW 2
# Merge guide_lug and all_guide_data by common columns
pre_guide_summary <- merge(guide_log, all_guide_data, by = c( "Study", "Participant ID", "Clinical Guide", "Secondary Guide"), all = TRUE)

# Reshape the data: pivot long to combine Clinical Guide and Secondary Guide into a single column
guide_summary_part1 <- pre_guide_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Clinical Guide`, `Secondary Guide`), # Pivot these two columns into key-value pairs
               names_to = "Guide_Type", # New column to indicate whether it's a Clinical or Secondary Guide
               values_to = "Guide" # Column for the guide name
               ) %>%
  filter(
        !is.na(Guide),
        !(tolower(`Guide`) == "test"),
        !is.na(`Participant ID`),
        `Participant ID` != ""
      ) %>% # Filter out rows where the guide is missing
  separate_rows(Guide, sep = "/") %>% # split guide names into rows
  mutate(
    `Guide` = standardize_name(`Guide`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Guide`) %>% # Group the data by each unique guide
  summarise(
    # Count the number of sessions per guide
    `Number of Sessions` = sum(grepl("sess|session", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("pre|post", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    
    # Count the number of `prep` visits for each guide (case-insensitive check)
    `Number of Prep Visits` = sum(grepl("prep", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE)), # Check if 'Visit Name' contains prep
    
    # Count the number of follow-up visits for each guide // CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES
    `Number of Follow-up Visits` = sum(grepl("fu|month|post|int|week|wk|mo|ltfu", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    
    # Calculate the total hours (convert to minutes to hours)
    `Hours Total` = sum(as.numeric(`Duration in Min`), na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
    
  )

### VIEW 3
#Convert `Visit Progress` to numeric
guide_summary_part2 <- guide_effort_table

guide_summary_part2$`Visit Progress` <- sapply(strsplit(guide_summary_part2$`Visit Progress`, "/"), function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2]))

# Pivot the guide_effort_table similarly as in View 2
guide_summary_part2 <- guide_summary_part2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Clinical Guide`, `Secondary Guide`), # Pivot these two columns into key-value pairs
               names_to = "Guide_Type", # New column to indicate whether it's a Clinical or Secondary Guide
               values_to = "Guide" # Column for the guide name
               ) %>%
  filter(
        !is.na(Guide),
        !(tolower(`Guide`) == "test"),
        !is.na(`Participant ID`),
        `Participant ID` != ""
      ) %>% # Filter out rows where the guide is missing
  separate_rows(Guide, sep = "/") %>% # split guide names into rows
  mutate(
    `Guide` = standardize_name(`Guide`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Guide`) %>% # Group the data by each unique guide
  summarise(
    # Count the total number of participants for each guide (distinct Participant ID and Study)
    `Total Participants` = n_distinct(`Participant ID`, `Study`),
    
    # Count how many participants have a Visit Progress of 1 (indicating they have completed the visit)
    `Participants Completed` = sum(`Visit Progress` >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Count how many participants are still in progress (Visit Progress greater than 1)
    `Participants in Progress` = sum(`Visit Progress` < 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r display, include = TRUE}
### SERVER LOGIC: THE BEHAVIOR AND FUNCTIONALITY OF THE APP
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Create a reactive value to store the filtered data
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    if(is.null(input$study) || length(input$study) == 0) {
      return(guide_effort_table[0, ]) # Return empty table with same columns
    }
    
    guide_effort_table %>%
      filter(
        (
          input$Guide == "SELECT GUIDE" |
            map_lgl(str_split(`Clinical Guide`, "/"), ~ input$Guide %in% .x) |
            map_lgl(str_split(`Secondary Guide`, "/"), ~ input$Guide %in% .x)
        ),
        (
          input$use_date_filter == FALSE |
            (`Start Date (First Prep)` >= input$date_range[1] & 
               `Start Date (First Prep)` <= input$date_range[2]
            )
        ),
        Study %in% input$study
      )
  })
  
  filtered_data_2 <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$study) || length(input$study) == 0) {
      return(pre_guide_summary[0, ])
    }
    pre_guide_summary %>%
      filter(
        (
          input$Guide == "SELECT GUIDE" |
            map_lgl(str_split(`Clinical Guide`, "/"), ~ input$Guide %in% .x) |
            map_lgl(str_split(`Secondary Guide`, "/"), ~ input$Guide %in% .x)
        ),
        (
          input$use_date_filter == FALSE |
            (
              `Start Date (First Prep)` >= input$date_range[1] &
                `Start Date (First Prep)` <= input$date_range[2]
            )|
             (`Date` >= input$date_range[1] &
                `Date` <= input$date_range[2])
           
        ),
        if (is.null(input$study) || length(input$study) == 0) FALSE else Study %in% input$study
      )
  })
  
  guide_summary_1 <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$study) || length(input$study) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        Guide = NA_character_,
        `Total Participants` = NA_integer_,
        `Participants in Progress` = NA_integer_,
        `Number of Sessions` = NA_integer_,
        `Number of Prep Visits` = NA_integer_,
        `Number of Follow-up Visits` = NA_integer_,
        `Hours Total` = NA_real_
      )[0, ]) # Empty tiblle with right structure
    }
    # Filtered data for generating the guide summary statistics
    guide_summary <- pre_guide_summary %>%
      filter(# Filter by Date range (checking either 'Start Date (First Prep)' or 'Date')
        (input$use_date_filter == FALSE |
           ((
             `Start Date (First Prep)` >= input$date_range[1] &
              `Start Date (First Prep)` <= input$date_range[2]
           ) |
             (`Date` >= input$date_range[1] &
                `Date` <= input$date_range[2])
           )), # Filter by Study
        Study %in% input$study) %>%
      # Pivot 'Clinical Guide' and 'Secondary Guide' into a long format
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(`Clinical Guide`, `Secondary Guide`),
        names_to = "Guide_Type",
        values_to = "Guide"
      ) %>%
      # Split guide names into rows
      separate_rows(Guide, sep = "/") %>%
      # Standardizes the guide names
      mutate(`Guide` = standardize_name(`Guide`)) %>%
      # Remove rows where Guide is missing
      filter(
        !is.na(Guide),
        !(tolower(`Guide`) == "test"),
        !is.na(`Participant ID`),
        `Participant ID` != ""
      ) %>%
      # Group by Guide
      group_by(Guide) %>%
      # Summarize key participant counts
      summarise(
        # Count the number of sessions per guide
        `Number of Sessions` = sum(grepl("sess|session", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("pre|post", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
        # Count the number of prep visits for each guide (case-insensitive check)
        `Number of Prep Visits` = sum(grepl("prep", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
        # Count the number of follow-up visits for each guide // CODE DEPENDENT ON STUDIES
        `Number of Follow-up Visits` = sum(
          grepl("fu|month|post|int|week|wk|mo|ltfu", `Visit Name`, ignore.case = TRUE),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        # Calculate the total hours (convert to minutes to hours)
        `Hours Total` = round(sum(as.numeric(
          `Duration in Min`
        ), na.rm = TRUE) / 60, 1),
      )
    
    
    
    # Calculate guide status (total participants, completed, and in progress)
    guide_status <- guide_effort_table %>%
      filter(# Filter by Date range (checking either 'Start Date (First Prep)' or 'Date')
        (input$use_date_filter == FALSE |
           ((
             `Start Date (First Prep)` >= input$date_range[1] &
               `Start Date (First Prep)` <= input$date_range[2]
           )
           )), # Filter by Study
        Study %in% input$study) %>%
      # Convert 'Visit Progress' into a numeric fraction
      mutate(`Visit Progress` = sapply(strsplit(`Visit Progress`, "/"), function(x)
        as.numeric(x[1]) / as.numeric(x[2]))) %>%
      # Pivot 'Clinical Guide' and 'Secondary Guide' into a long format
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(`Clinical Guide`, `Secondary Guide`),
        names_to = "Guide_Type",
        values_to = "Guide"
      ) %>%
      # Split guide names into rows
      separate_rows(Guide, sep = "/") %>%
      # Standardizes the guide names
      mutate(`Guide` = standardize_name(`Guide`)) %>%
      # Remove rows where Guide is missing
      filter(
        !is.na(Guide),
        !(tolower(`Guide`) == "test"),
        !is.na(`Participant ID`),
        `Participant ID` != ""
      ) %>%
      # Group by Guide
      group_by(Guide) %>%
      # Summarize key participant counts
      summarise(
        `Total Participants` = n_distinct(`Participant ID`, Study),
        `Participants Completed` = sum(`Visit Progress` >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Participants in Progress` = sum(`Visit Progress` < 1, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    
    # Combine for center thing
    merge(guide_status,
          guide_summary,
          by = c("Guide"),
          all = TRUE)
  })
  
  
  # Reset filters to their initial state when the 'Reset' button is clicked
  observeEvent(input$reset_filter, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "Guide", selected = "SELECT GUIDE")
    updateDateRangeInput(
      session,
      "date_range",
      start = min(guide_effort_table$`Start Date (First Prep)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      end = max(
        guide_effort_table$`End Date (last integration before follow-up)`,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
    updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "study", selected = as.character(unique(guide_effort_table$Study)))
  })
  
  # Render the filtered guide effort table using DataTables (with custom options)
  output$filtered_table <- renderDT({
    req(filtered_data(), guide_summary_1()) # Ensure the filtered data is available
    if (input$Guide == "ALL GUIDES") {
      datatable(
        guide_summary_1(),
        options = list(
          scrollX = TRUE,
          scrollY = "500px",
          paging = FALSE,
          # Removes pagination
          searching = FALSE,
          # Removes search bar
          pageLength = 10    # Sets the number of rows per page
        ),
        rownames = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      datatable(
        filtered_data(),
        options = list(
          scrollX = TRUE,
          scrollY = "500px",
          paging = FALSE,
          # Removes pagination
          searching = FALSE,
          # Removes search bar
          pageLength = 10    # Sets the number of rows per page
        ),
        rownames = FALSE
      )
    }
  })
  
  
  # Generate and display summary statistics for the selected guide
  output$summary_text <- renderUI({
    req(guide_summary_1(),
        input$Guide,
        input$study,
        input$date_range)
    
    if (input$Guide == "ALL GUIDES" ||
        input$Guide == "SELECT GUIDE") {
      return(
        HTML(
          "<p><strong>Guide Name:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Total Participants:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Participants In Progress:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Participants Completed:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Number of Sessions:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Number of Prep Visits:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Follow-Up Visits:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Hours Total:</strong> <br> NA</p>"
        )
      )
    }
    
    if (is.null(input$Guide) || input$Guide == "" || nrow(guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide)) == 0) {
      return(
        HTML(
          "<p><strong>Guide Name:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Total Participants:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Participants In Progress:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Participants Completed:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Number of Sessions:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Number of Prep Visits:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Follow-Up Visits:</strong> <br> NA<br>
               <strong>Hours Total:</strong> <br> NA</p>"
        )
      )
    }
    
    HTML(
      paste0(
        "<p><strong>Guide Name:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(Guide),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Total Participants:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Total Participants`),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Participants In Progress:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Participants in Progress`),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Participants Completed:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Participants Completed`),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Number of Sessions:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Number of Sessions`),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Number of Prep Visits:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Number of Prep Visits`),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Follow-Up Visits:</strong> <br>",
        guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Number of Follow-up Visits`),
        "<br>",
        "<strong>Hours Total:</strong> <br>",
        round(
          guide_summary_1() %>% filter(`Guide` == input$Guide) %>% pull(`Hours Total`),
          1
        ),
        "</p>"
      )
    )
  })
  
  
}

### RUN THE SHINY APP WITH THE UI AND SERVER LOGIC
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
